family.description: This entry represents the alpha helical (AH) domain found in RelA/SpoT proteins, adjacent to the ACT domain [[cite:PUB00095792],[cite:PUB00098872]]. The AH domain interacts with A/R tRNA and links the very C-terminal subdomains with TGS domain. RelA/SpoT-homologue proteins (RHS) mediate the stringent response in bacteria which enables its metabolic adaptation under stress conditions. These enzymes synthesise the second messenger (p)ppGpp, which is a regulatory metabolite of the stringent response characterised by growth arrest and the modulation of gene expression in response to various nutritional stresses [[cite:PUB00095792],[cite:PUB00098872],[cite:PUB00059269]].
family.name: RelA/SpoT AH domain
